text:
marta (community): Quick heads-up: we just published coordinated community updates — Maintainer rotation process, Contributor Guidelines v2, and a 48-hour L10N hackathon. Sign-up + details: https://rwd.co/l10n-hack :tada:

sarah (eng-oss): Where's the maintainer rotation doc?

marta (community): https://github.com/redwood-inference/community/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#rotation. New process reduces on-call churn and includes handover notes. Read before volunteering.

leila (i18n): Added a translation playbook and a tiny TM export so contributors can reuse strings. Docs: https://rwd.co/i18n-playbook

ryan (product): Are there bounties or swag for top contributors during the hackathon?

marta (community): Yes — small grant pool, stickers, and priority PR review for significant contributions. Winners will be featured in the community newsletter.

daniel (maintainer): I'll be lead maintainer for first rotation window (May 4-17). I'll host an async office hour on May 6 16:00 UTC for new maintainers.

leila (i18n): Can we add an APAC-friendly slot? Volunteers are across timezones.

marta (community): Added a second slot: May 7 02:00 UTC. Both recorded; notes posted.

sarah (eng-oss): Contributor Guidelines v2: is there a PR readiness checklist?

marta (community): Yes — v2 includes a PR checklist. Highlights: automated lint + CI labels, i18n-ready strings, lightweight changelog entry. Example snippet:
```
- Add changelog entry under /CHANGELOG.md
- Run `yarn test` and `yarn lint:docs`
- Mark PR with `i18n-needed` if user-facing text changed
```

dev-bot: Event created: "L10N Hackathon" (2026-05-08 00:00 UTC -> 2026-05-09 23:59 UTC). Calendar invite sent to #community.

leila (i18n): We'll prep starter tasks (translation pairs, UI strings, README localization) and reviewer quick guides.

ryan (product): I'll coordinate priority triage for PRs tied to partner previews.

marta (community): If you want to mentor during the hackathon, add your GitHub handle: https://rwd.co/l10n-vols. Sign-up deadline: April 30.

sarah (eng-oss): Signed up.

daniel (maintainer): I'll add a `good-first-l10n` label and a starter issue template.

marta (community): Final note: Contributor Guidelines v2 is effective immediately. Small edits welcome via PRs. We'll host an AMA after the hackathon. :sparkles:
